name: canvas
title: world.canvas
lead: Makes a picture of `width` by `height` maps (1 by 1 by default, 16 at most a side) with no frame of its own, for a frame, a hand or a screen.
signature: world.canvas(opts: { width: number ?, height: number ? }?) → Canvas

usedIn.quote: local c = world.canvas{}              -- one map; world.canvas{ width = 4, height = 2 } is 4 by 2 maps (16 at most a side)
item = "paper",                     -- canonical item name; or canvas = c, a world.canvas{}: a filled map of the picture
